    Selected work / Independent prototype

    Daybook. More than a screen.

    A working booking interface, a request queue and a simulated connected device. When a connection fails, the request stays visible until it can be delivered.

    The interesting part is what happens next.

    Validation prevents conflicting bookings. A stable request identity keeps a replay from creating another delivery. The product and its 3D system share the same local state.

    Built as an independent experiment, not a commissioned client project. All booking and device activity stays in this prototype.
